summary: @servicetitan/standalone-tm-api 1.1.1 ships an obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches Bun and executes a bundled opaque payload
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (_0xNNNNNN identifiers, dictionary-object indirection hiding URLs, argv, chmod mode 0o755, and file names). At install time it downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses that freshly downloaded runtime to execFileSync the shipped math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line bundle with a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW rotator + n7gIxM array + hc1jfK9 decoder, obfuscator.io pattern) carrying a @bun/@bun-cjs header, so it only runs under Bun and is invisible to Node-based install-time scanners. The advertised purpose of the package is an auto-generated NSwag axios REST SDK for ServiceTitan's tenant management API; neither Bun nor a 727KB obfuscated bundle is required for that purpose. The CHANGELOG has no entry for 1.1.1 and the prior version was authored by a personal GitHub account, consistent with a malicious point release published into the @servicetitan scope. Installing the package on default `npm install` executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's host via an alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
